name: Índice de Inquietud Pupilar
description: Analiza la inquietud pupilar para detectar videos generados por IA
algorithm: Algoritmo de análisis Pupillary Unrest Index
mechanism:
This method analyzes pupillary unrest (hippus) for deepfake detection:

1. **Pupila Size Medición**: Pupil diameter is measured per frame using iris-pupil boundary detection and ellipse fitting. High-resolution tracking captures the temporal signal of pupil diameter changes.

2. **Hippus Detección**: Pupillary unrest (hippus) is the continuous, involuntary oscillation of pupil diameter at frequencies of 0.5-2 Hz with amplitude of 0.2-0.5mm. This is a normal physiological phenomenon reflecting sympathetic-parasympathetic nervous system interplay. The method checks for the presence and characteristics of hippus.

3. **Pupillary Luz Reflex**: When illumination changes, pupils should constrict (light increase) or dilate (light decrease) with characteristic latency (~200ms) and dynamics (rapid constriction, slower dilation). The method checks for correct pupillary light reflex dynamics. Deepfakes typically don't model this physiological response.

4. **Bilateral Pupila Coordination**: Both pupils should show consensual response — constricting/dilating together with minimal difference (≤0.5mm). The method checks bilateral pupil size correlation. AI generators may produce independent pupil sizes between left and right eyes, violating the consensual pupil response.

5. **Cognitive Pupila Response**: Cognitive effort and emotional arousal produce small pupil dilations (0.1-0.5mm above baseline). The method analyzes whether pupil size correlates with speech content complexity and emotional context. Deepfake pupils that don't respond to cognitive demands lack this natural physiological signal.
parameters: Tipo de análisis: estadístico automático\nRango de puntuación: 0 (auténtico) a 100 (generado por IA)
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-85% de precisión según la calidad de entrada.
source: Basado en investigación revisada por pares en forense digital y detección de contenido IA.
useCase: Se utiliza como parte del pipeline de análisis multiseñal para detectar contenido generado por IA.
strengths: • Metodología respaldada por investigación\n• Tiempo de cálculo rápido\n• Complementario a otros métodos de detección
limitations: • La precisión varía con la calidad de entrada\n• Mejor utilizado en combinación con otros métodos
